answer: Re-attestations are stored in nebula and lagoon lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the bridge graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 911 impostors cost 1499 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
